title: Bio-IT World FAIR Data Hackathon
bodyHtml:
The CFDE Training Center invites you to participate in the sixth annual Bio-IT World FAIR Data Hackathon in Boston, MA on April 1–2, 2025!

Collaborate with data scientists, developers, and life science professionals to tackle real-world data challenges. Focused on Open Source and FAIR Data principles, this two-day event fosters innovation and collaboration to deliver practical solutions.

Projects include:

  • Project 1: GlycoEnzyme Expression Atlas: Linking Differential Expression to Pathway Dysregulation
  • Project 2: DrugCentral Based Review and Profiles of Targets for Approved Drugs
  • Project 3: Mapping Disease at the Cellular Level with HuBMAP
  • Project 4: Unraveling Exercise Resilience: Multi-Omics Meets Machine Learning
  • Project 5: Interactive Analysis with Biological Pathways
  • Project 6: FAIR Maturity Matrix Assessment: The DATA Dimension

Participation in this event is free, but registration is required. Register or learn more here.
